title: El quesillo
goal: Eat a quesillo and survive the bag it comes in
culture: Cheese, cream, pickled onion and salt in a tortilla, served in a plastic bag. The bag is not a mistake — you drink the cream out of the corner of it when the tortilla is gone, and everybody watching will be pleased that you knew to.

beats.good: Cheese, cream, pickled onion and salt, in a tortilla, in a bag. La Paz Centro and Nagarote argue about who does it best and neither of them is here.
Con todo again — the same answer you gave about the beans. It is the default reply to every ¿con qué? in this country.
The pickled onion is the strongest thing in there and asking for it without offends nobody.

beats.es: (Se lo pasa en la bolsa, goteando.)
beats.good: Está rico is what you say with your mouth full and it is expected. Saying nothing at all reads as not liking it.
